§6DFC Components & Operation§f

§aEmitter, receiver, stabilizer, injector. Cool the emitter or it becomes lava.§f

§bEmitter§f: Supplies energy to trigger the reaction. §cMust be cooled with cryogel§f or it melts into a lava source block instantly. Output adjustable 1-100%. Multiple emitters can be chained at 95% efficiency each.

§bReceiver§f: Absorbs the beam and outputs electricity. Must point toward the beam arrival direction. Also requires cryogel cooling.

§bStabilizer§f: Contains the core reaction via a restriction field. Requires a lens (high durability, eventually needs replacement). Output adjustable 1-100%, higher values mean stronger restriction but more power and lens wear. If restriction hits 0%, the DFC explodes.

§bFuel Injector§f: Supplies two fuel types to the core via pipes. No container slots, fluid identifiers auto-update fuel types. No power required.

§bTungsten Crate§f: Alternative to the receiver. Uses beam heat to instantly smelt items and transmute polonium-210 into yharonite.

§cWARNING:§f Heat saturation reaching 100% also causes an explosion. Monitor both restriction and heat levels at all times.

§ePS:§f Use 2 stabilizers for redundancy. Install a High Energy Field Jammer before first startup.
